title: Image Converter input

url.title: Image URL
url.description: Direct, publicly downloadable URL of ONE image (http/https). Input formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF (first frame), TIFF, BMP, ICO and others Pillow reads. Max 50 MB and 100 megapixels. Example: https://download.samplelib.com/png/sample-boat-400x300.png

files.title: Batch
files.description: Optional batch. Array of objects: {"url": string (required), plus any of target, quality, maxWidth, maxHeight, maxBytes, stripMetadata to override the top-level value for that image}. Example: [{"url":"https://example.com/a.png","target":"avif","maxWidth":800},{"url":"https://example.com/b.jpg","maxBytes":100000}]. Plain URL strings also accepted. Failed images return status=error and are not charged.

target.title: Output format
target.description: Output format. Default: webp. webp = best general web choice; avif = smallest files, slower to encode; jpeg = universal (transparency is flattened onto white); png = lossless, keeps transparency; gif = first frame only; tiff = archival/print.

quality.title: Quality (1-100)
quality.description: Encoder quality 1-100 for jpeg/webp/avif (ignored for png/gif/tiff). Default 80. ~75-85 is visually lossless for photos; lower = smaller files. If maxBytes is set, this is the starting/maximum quality.

maxWidth.title: Max width (px)
maxWidth.description: Optional maximum output width in pixels, e.g. 1200. Image is downscaled proportionally to fit (aspect ratio kept, never upscaled). Combine with maxHeight to fit inside a box.

maxHeight.title: Max height (px)
maxHeight.description: Optional maximum output height in pixels, e.g. 800. Downscales proportionally (never upscales).

maxBytes.title: Target max file size (bytes)
maxBytes.description: Optional target maximum output size in BYTES (e.g. 150000 = ~150 KB). Quality is automatically lowered (binary search) until the file fits. Only for jpeg/webp/avif. If it cannot fit even at very low quality, the item errors (not charged) - add maxWidth to shrink dimensions too.

stripMetadata.title: Strip EXIF/GPS metadata
stripMetadata.description: Default true: removes EXIF, GPS location, camera and other metadata from the output (privacy-safe for user uploads). Orientation is applied to pixels first so images stay upright. Set false to keep EXIF (jpeg/webp).

description: Convert, resize and compress public image URLs. Pass `url` for one image or `files` for a batch; top-level options apply to all, per-item fields override. Outputs are download URLs in the dataset.
